head.t: Kerry Holden begins her Presidency of the Infection Prevention Society
head.x: The Infection Prevention Society (IPS) is delighted to announce that Kerry Holden has officially begun her term as President, following a memorable IP2026 conference in Leeds. Kerry formally took over as President during the conference, handed over from Jude Robinson, who has led the Society over the past two years.

head.t: A heartfelt farewell as Jude Robinson hands over the IPS Presidency
head.x: After two years at the helm of the Infection Prevention Society (IPS), Jude has officially handed over the presidency to Kerry Holden, marking the end of a leadership tenure defined by authenticity, courage and an unwavering commitment to members.
